citations.text: M. Gamst, D. Pisinger (2024). Decision support for the technician routing and scheduling problem. Networks 83(1), 169-196.

description: Instance sets and raw results for the technician routing and scheduling problem of Gamst and Pisinger, including the instances of Mathlouthi, Gendreau and Potvin and a further technician dispatch set called TDCData.
name: Technician dispatch data (Mathlouthi, Gendreau and Potvin)

recipe.reason: The instances are a custom sectioned text format whose tasks have no positions, and the collection is hundreds of megabytes compressed, almost all of it a pairwise travel time matrix that tasks/v1 has no arcs to hold, so reading it would hold gigabytes in memory to keep a few fields per task.
